proof_body:
by
  intro a b c h hs
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    norm_num at h
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    norm_num at h
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    norm_num at h
  have e₁ : 1 / a = b * c := by
    field_simp
    linear_combination -h
  have e₂ : 1 / b = c * a := by
    field_simp
    linear_combination -h
  have e₃ : 1 / c = a * b := by
    field_simp
    linear_combination -h
  rw [e₁, e₂, e₃] at hs
  have hp : (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1) = 0 := by linear_combination h + hs
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with hp | hp
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with hp | hp
    · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp hp)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp hp))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp hp))
